verdicts.rationale: _destroyed_numeric_tokens at reconstruct.py:377 filters candidates with anchored _NUM_TOKEN_RE.match(text) AND _NUMERIC_RE.search(text). That anchored regex rejects 0.67***, U+2212, $0.67, (0.14) — exactly the decorated numerics this repo already accepts elsewhere via native_verifier.is_numeric_token at native_verifier.py:488, which strips presentation first. If the text-strategy grid splits '0.67***' the same way it split '0.67', A2 never fires and a silent wrong number ships. Fix: drive the candidate filter with is_numeric_token (presentation-strip first). Survival predicate stays exact-string 'text in raw_cell' on the original token.
